literal_meaning: চোখ ছানাবড়ার মতো (ফোলা বা বিস্ফোরিত চোখ)
figurative_meaning_en: Eyes bulging or popping out in astonishment
similar_in_english: Eyes popped out of one's head
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খবর শুনে তার চক্ষু ছানাবড়া হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon hearing the news, his eyes popped out in surprise.
Everyone's eyes bulged at the sight of the incident.
note: The idiom draws from the visual of sprouted chickpeas (ছানা) swelling, metaphorically representing bulging eyes in shock.
